heading: Set up your controller
intro: Plug your controller into the computer with its cable, then press the big button.
working: Setting up... this takes about a minute. Please wait.
uacHint: Windows will ask "Do you want to allow this?" - click Yes.
uacCancelled: You clicked No. Press the button again and choose Yes.
doneMsg: Unplug the cable and press the round PS button in the middle to play.
removeDone: Removed. The controller setup was taken off this PC.
failMsg: Something didn't work. Try again, or open the details.
removeConfirm: This removes the controller setup from this PC. Continue?
engineMissing: Setup-PS3-Controller.cmd was not found next to this app. Put 'Start Here.cmd' and the 'gui' folder in the same folder as Setup-PS3-Controller.cmd.
